description: SLS 5.9 interaction walk positioned in time (s6-interaction-v5, audit mechanism M12, 2026-09-14). The walk used to start at a zone's stored confirmed_index + 1 and stop at a terminal transition's stored candle_index -- offsets inside whichever window wrote them -- so every zone born at the window tail (all FVG/IFVG/BPR/BREAKER on the host) never received an interaction. Each mutation restores one frozen offset. Deterministic tests (no Hypothesis), so one battery run is a verdict. Run from backend/: uv run python -m tests.support.mutation_battery tests/mutations/interaction_walk_rebase.json

mutations.name: the walk starts at the zone's stored window-local offset again
the walk stops at the terminal transition's stored window-local offset again
mutations.new: return min(t.candle_index for t in transitions if t.to_state in _TERMINAL_STATES)
